results.instruction: Сформируй PostgreSQL SELECT: Покажи scenarios с количеством technical errors за все evaluation runs.
results.expected_sql: SELECT scenario_id, scenario_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE error IS NOT NULL) AS technical_errors FROM evaluation_results GROUP BY scenario_id, scenario_name ORDER BY technical_errors DESC, scenario_id
results.response:
```sql
SELECT 
    er.scenario_id,
    COUNT(er.id) AS technical_error_count
FROM 
    evaluation_results er
WHERE 
    er.error LIKE '%technical error%'
GROUP BY 
    er.scenario_id;
```
results.extracted_sql:
SELECT 
    er.scenario_id,
    COUNT(er.id) AS technical_error_count
FROM 
    evaluation_results er
WHERE 
    er.error LIKE '%technical error%'
GROUP BY 
    er.scenario_id

results.instruction: Нужен read-only SQL для аналитики: Посчитай marker failures по model из evaluation_results.
results.expected_sql: SELECT model, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE((quality_flags->>'response_has_required_markers')::boolean, TRUE)) AS marker_failures FROM evaluation_results GROUP BY model ORDER BY marker_failures DESC
results.response:
```sql
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS marker_failures
FROM evaluation_results
WHERE error IS NOT NULL AND error LIKE '%marker failure%'
GROUP BY model;
```

results.instruction: Нужен read-only SQL для аналитики: Найди summaries, которые давно не обновлялись.
results.expected_sql: SELECT session_id, message_count_at_update, updated_at FROM conversation_summaries ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT 20
results.response:

SELECT cs.id, cs.session_id, cs.summary, cs.message_count_at_update, cs.features, cs.metadata_json, cs.created_at, cs.updated_at

results.instruction: Покажи последние RAG requests вместе с количеством source logs.
results.expected_sql: SELECT r.id, r.created_at, r.model, COUNT(s.id) AS source_count FROM rag_request_logs r LEFT JOIN rag_source_logs s ON s.request_log_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.created_at, r.model ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
results.response:
```sql
WITH latest_rag_requests AS (
    SELECT id, message, response, model, provider, latency_ms, collection, score_threshold, features, source_types, diversity, retrieval, query_hints, context_policy, prompt_tokens_estimate, created_at
    FROM rag_request_logs
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
source_counts AS (
    SELECT request_log_id, COUNT(*) AS source_count
    FROM rag_source_logs
    GROUP BY request_log_id
)
SELECT lrr.*, COALESCE(sc.source_count, 0) AS source_count
FROM latest_rag_requests lrr
LEFT JOIN source_counts sc ON lrr.id = sc.request_log_id;
```
